description: Screenshot of a tweet from Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) demanding an investigation of Nancy Pelosi for alleged ties to Russia, quoting a linked politico.com article headlined that a photo contradicts Pelosi's statement about not meeting Ambassador Kislyak. The embedded photo shows Pelosi seated at a long formal dining table with a Russian delegation from a 2010 meeting; the men at left are consistent with Dmitry Medvedev and Sergey Lavrov. The article caption claims the Democratic House leader sat with the Russian ambassador and other officials in 2010.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. I hereby demand a second investigation, after Schumer, of Pelosi for her close ties to Russia, and lying about it. Photo contradicts Pelosi's statement about not meeting Kislyak. The Democratic House leader sat with the Russian ambassador and other officials in 2010. politico.com
flags: Identification of Medvedev, Lavrov and Kislyak in the photo is based on the article caption and likeness, not on-image labels
The tweet's claim that Pelosi lied is unverified; carried as a claim

description: Political cartoon by Ben Garrison titled 'Gulliver's President'. A giant Donald Trump, tied down Gulliver-style with ropes staked to the ground by small caricatured figures labeled as Democratic politicians, officials and media figures (Maxine Waters, Ilhan Omar, Robert Mueller, Andrew McCabe, Peter Strzok, Jim Acosta with a CNN camera, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez labeled 'Ocrazyo Cortez', Adam Schiff, Rod Rosenstein, Rashida Tlaib, Hillary Clinton, Barack Obama, James Comey, Eric Swalwell, Nancy Pelosi, Chuck Schumer, George Soros, a figure in a boat labeled '9th Circuit', and a pyramid-headed figure labeled 'Fed Res.'), reaches out to press a red button on an American-flag device labeled 'EMERGENCY' near the U.S. Capitol. The cartoon depicts Trump declaring a national emergency (the February 2019 border-wall emergency) despite obstruction; the caricatures carry the artist's satirical labels.
text: IMPEACH!. MAXINE WATERS. OMAR. PING!. MUELLER. PING!. EMERGENCY. McCABE. STRZOK. NO WALL. 9TH CIRCUIT. SOROS. ROSENSTEIN. YOU M#FGR!. CNN. ACOSTA. OCRAZYO CORTEZ. SCHIFF. TLAIB. HEH HEH!. HILLARY. FED RES.. OBAMA. COMEY. SCHUMER. SWALWELL. PELOSI. GULLIVER'S PRESIDENT. BEN GARRISON. (C)GRRRGRAPHICS.COM
flags: Satirical caricature; depictions and labels are the cartoonist's editorial claims, including the mocking label 'Ocrazyo Cortez' and a pyramid-headed Federal Reserve figure

description: Zoomed-in crop of the emergency-button device from Ben Garrison's 'Gulliver's President' cartoon: a finger presses a red button mounted on an American-flag-faced box labeled 'EMERGENCY', flanked by gold horns, with a blue siren light on top. A green hand-drawn circle annotates the siren dome, highlighting what appears to be a letter 'Q' shape in the swirls of the blue light — the annotation implies a hidden Q reference in the cartoon.
flags: The green circle is an annotator's claim that a 'Q' is hidden in the siren light; whether the shape is an intentional Q is unverified

description: Phone-recorded video of a Philips television playing a CBS network drama (CBS eye logo bug on screen); the source filename attributes it to Twitter users @shadygrooove and @intheMatrixxx and captions it 'Just now on NCIS NEW ORLEANS'. The frames show scripted scenes: a bearded man in a plaid shirt holding a mug and speaking to a woman, a wide kitchen scene with several characters, and a bearded man in glasses conversing with a woman in a doorway. The clip was circulated as a purported QAnon reference airing on the show; the actors are not identified from the frames.
flags: Show identification as NCIS: New Orleans comes from the filename/sharer caption, not on-screen titles
The claim that the scene references QAnon is the sharers' claim; the frames alone do not show it

description: Screenshot of Q drop #2791 from a dark-themed Q aggregator site, dated 18 Feb 2019. The drop quotes an Anonymous post claiming DNI Dan Coats would be forced out soon, sourcing the claim to Trump friend Chris Ruddy; Q replies that it is interesting this leaked already. The claim about Coats' forced departure is the quoted post's claim.
text: New: Title TBD. 2791. Q !!mG7VJxZNCI 18 Feb 2019 - 12:15:21 PM. Anonymous 18 Feb 2019 - 12:10:18 PM. DAN COATS OUT [FORCED] (SOON) - Source = Trump friend Chris Ruddy. >>5245512. Interesting this leaked already. Q
flags: The claim that Dan Coats would be forced out, attributed to Chris Ruddy, is unverified and carried as the post's claim
